slots.name: incident date
slots.sentence: He then arranged for a taxi to take her from her home to his house in St Werburghs in the early hours of 30 November where he and the three others carried out the attacks.

slots.name: perpetrator age
slots.sentence: The 17-year-old boy was arrested at the scene, but the three men fled from officers and travelled to Birmingham and London before they left the country in a lorry.

slots.name: victim arrival date
slots.sentence: The victim came to Bristol for the first time on 25 November 2025 with a friend on a Christmas shopping trip.

slots.name: communication duration
slots.sentence: Det Sgt Jo Babbage said the victim had begun communicating with Safi five days before the attacks "via mobile, predominantly Snapchat".

slots.name: victim age
slots.sentence: Safi first met the 17-year-old girl, who cannot be named for legal reasons, while she was Christmas shopping, and groomed her over Snapchat before paying for a taxi to bring her to Bristol.
